subject.title: fix(gateway): deliver payload-scoped observer events to subscribed scoped clients; fence companion from workspace onboarding

question: Should this combined gateway-delivery and companion-role repair be approved after maintainers confirm the session-scope authorization boundary and required CI complete?
rationale: The patch changes delivery at a capability-gated, session-scoped boundary and the PR carries the repository’s protected `maintainer` label; that approval cannot be inferred from tests or the supplied live run alone.

options.title: Approve after boundary review
options.body: Confirm payload-derived session scope remains subject to the existing access and per-session subscription checks, then merge once required CI is green.

options.title: Split the repairs
options.body: Separate the prompt-only companion fence if maintainers want its behavioral policy reviewed independently from gateway event delivery.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary review
recommendation.body: Confirm payload-derived session scope remains subject to the existing access and per-session subscription checks, then merge once required CI is green.
